definitions.explanation: The act of maintaining social relationships or keeping company with others.
A romantic involvement between two people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Getting along with neighbors is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}みに→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went drinking as a work social obligation.

examples.notes: {付|つ}き{合|あ}いがいい = sociable, easy to get along with

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The two of them have been together for a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've been dating him for half a year.
examples.notes: お{付|つ}き{合|あ}い is the polite form, often used for romantic relationships

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦だけど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Socializing with friends is important, but I also want to treasure family time.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (sociable, easy to get along with)
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (unsociable, hard to get along with)
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do ~ as a social obligation)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (neighborly relations)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (work-related socializing)
- お{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (polite form; also used for romantic relationship)

USAGE:
{付|つ}き{合|あ}い often implies social obligations that one feels compelled to participate in, especially in business contexts.
